PNN-002 Awaiting the announcement

Last to announce. Too early to bribe.

After finishing last in the name reveal, the Black Webb Bandits attempted a dramatic recovery: arriving before bribing had even opened. Their reward? The opportunity to do it all again.

Subject team
Black Webb Bandits
Opened
October 6, 2026 at 8:28 PM (America/Denver)
PNN threat rating
Chronologically unpredictable

The incident

The Black Webb Bandits were last to announce their name. Having apparently decided that being late once was quite enough, they left treats and an "Are you a witch?" flier before the witches had announced instructions for bribing. A bold leap from behind schedule to ahead of permission. Wanda, Hilda, and Glenda then reminded the teams that every early bribe would receive a NO. The Bandits had successfully expedited their return trip.

Previously on the PNN desk: PNN-001 — Caught in their own Webb

The witches' reminder

Wanda, Hilda, & Glenda · October 6, 2026 at 8:28 PM (America/Denver) ? edited

⚠️ A WARNING FROM THE WITCHES ⚠️

Some teams seem to be eager to find us… a little too eager. 🧙‍♀️

Wait for our instructions before bribing. We will answer NO to every bribe until the instructions are announced.

If you try to bribe us before then, your penalty is simple: you’ll have to bribe us again once the announcement is made.

The witches are watching. 👀

Wait for the announcement. Save your treats. And whatever you do… don’t anger the witches.

🧙‍♀️ You have been warned. 🧙‍♂️

Suspected motive

PNN theory: compensate for the late name reveal by being spectacularly early to the next thing. Unfortunately, the next thing was waiting. They have now demonstrated a remarkable ability to arrive on either side of the correct time.

Investigator's note

Clueso was prepared to blame the Prowling Purrpetrators. Then he read the name on the flier. The Bandits had helpfully signed their own scheduling incident. Eight legs, a printed invitation, and still nobody on the brakes.

Official PNN assessment

Last to introduce themselves. Early to ask the question. Required to bring treats again. The witches get another round; the Bandits get another chance to locate the starting line. PNN recommends waiting for the announcement before attempting any further improvements in punctuality.
